offers.title: Apple Education Store student pricing
offers.summary: Discounted Mac and iPad pricing for students, plus seasonal free-gift-card promotions.
offers.body:
The Apple Education Store offers **lower prices on Mac and iPad** for students. During the back-to-school season, you can often get a **free gift card or accessory** on qualifying purchases.

## What you get
- Education pricing on most Mac and iPad models
- Discounted AppleCare+
- Seasonal promos (gift cards / free accessories) at certain times of year

## How to claim
1. Visit the [Apple Education Store](https://www.apple.com/us-edu/store) for your country.
2. Confirm eligibility (often via UNiDAYS student verification).
3. The education price shows automatically for eligible products.

## Good to know
Discount amounts and the back-to-school promo vary by region and season. Verification may be requested after purchase.
offers.eligibility: Current and newly accepted college students, parents, and staff

offers.title: Autodesk Education licences
offers.summary: Free education access to Fusion 360, AutoCAD, Maya, Revit and more for eligible students.
offers.body:
Autodesk gives students **free education licences** to its professional design and engineering software: the same tools used across architecture, product design and film.

## What you get
- Fusion 360, AutoCAD, Maya, 3ds Max, Revit, Inventor and more
- Full professional features under an education licence
- Access for the duration of your eligibility

## How to claim
1. Go to [autodesk.com/education](https://www.autodesk.com/education/edu-software/overview).
2. Create an Autodesk account and verify academic status via SheerID.
3. Download and activate the products you need.

## Good to know
Education licences are for **learning, not commercial work**. They renew while you stay verified. Re-confirm your status yearly.
offers.eligibility: Students and educators 13+ at accredited institutions

offers.title: Microsoft Azure for Students
offers.summary: $100 in Azure credit plus free developer services, no credit card required.
offers.body:
Azure for Students gives you **$100 of cloud credit with no credit card**. It's one of the easiest ways to host projects, run VMs and try managed databases for free.

## What you get
- $100 Azure credit, valid for 12 months
- Free tiers of popular services (App Service, Functions, databases)
- Free access to select developer tools and learning paths

## How to claim
1. Go to [azure.microsoft.com/free/students](https://azure.microsoft.com/free/students/).
2. Sign in with your school account and verify academic status.
3. No payment method is required to start.

## Good to know
Renewable yearly while you stay a verified student. If you have the GitHub Student Pack, additional Azure benefits may stack.
offers.eligibility: Students 18+ at accredited institutions (no card needed)

offers.title: Canva for Education
offers.summary: Canva Pro features free for eligible students and teachers: templates, brand kit, background remover.
offers.body:
Canva for Education gives eligible schools **Canva Pro-level tools for free**: premium templates, the Background Remover, Magic tools, and a brand kit.

## What you get
- Thousands of premium templates and design elements
- Background Remover and Magic design tools
- Class and group collaboration features

## How to claim
1. Visit [canva.com/education](https://www.canva.com/education/).
2. Verify as a teacher, or join as a student via a teacher invite or eligible institution.
3. Access applies once your school is verified.

## Good to know
Eligibility for higher-ed students varies by country and institution. If Canva for Education isn't available to you, students can still get a free Pro trial.
offers.eligibility: K-12 and eligible higher-ed students and educators

offers.title: Coursera Financial Aid
offers.summary: Apply for financial aid to take paid courses and earn certificates for free.
offers.body:
Coursera lets you **apply for financial aid on most paid courses**. If approved, you take the full course and earn the certificate **for free**.

## What you get
- Full access to graded assignments and the shareable certificate
- Works on individual courses (and many Specializations, course by course)

## How to claim
1. Open a paid course and choose **Financial aid available** below the Enroll button.
2. Fill in the short application (why you need aid, how the course helps).
3. Approval typically takes about 15 days; then enroll for free.

## Good to know
You apply per course, and there's a short waiting period. Auditing many courses is also free if you only need the material, not the certificate.
offers.eligibility: Anyone who can't afford the course fee

offers.title: Figma Education plan
offers.summary: Figma's paid Professional features, free for verified students and educators.
offers.body:
The Figma Education plan gives students the **Professional tier for free**: unlimited files, version history, team libraries and dev-friendly handoff.

## What you get
- Unlimited Figma design files and projects
- Shared team libraries and advanced prototyping
- FigJam for whiteboarding and planning

## How to claim
1. Go to [figma.com/education](https://www.figma.com/education/) and apply.
2. Verify your student/educator status via SheerID.
3. The plan applies to your account and any education team you create.

## Good to know
Verification lasts about a year; you'll be asked to re-verify to keep the plan. Great paired with the design skills in the GitHub Student Pack.
offers.eligibility: Students and educators 13+ at accredited institutions

offers.title: GitHub Student Developer Pack
offers.summary: The biggest bundle of free developer tools for students: 100+ offers in one verification.
offers.body:
The GitHub Student Developer Pack is the best first stop for any student who codes. One verification gets you **100+ partner offers**: cloud credits, free Pro tiers, domains, learning platforms and more.

## What you get
- **GitHub Copilot Pro** free while you're a verified student
- Free credits on DigitalOcean, Microsoft Azure and Heroku alternatives
- A **free `.me` domain + SSL** via Namecheap
- Free tiers of JetBrains, Sentry, Datadog, and dozens more

## How to claim
1. Sign in to GitHub with the email your school issued.
2. Go to [education.github.com/pack](https://education.github.com/pack) and click **Get student benefits**.
3. Verify with SheerID (school email or proof of enrolment).

## Good to know
Approval is usually instant with a `.edu`-style email; otherwise upload proof of enrolment. Benefits refresh while you stay verified, so re-verify each year.
offers.eligibility: Students 13+ enrolled in a degree or diploma-granting course

offers.title: Google Cloud free tier + trial credit
offers.summary: $300 in free trial credit plus an always-free tier for small workloads and student projects.
offers.body:
Google Cloud's free offering combines a **$300 trial credit** (90 days) with an **always-free tier**. That's enough to host side projects, run a small VM, or learn managed services.

## What you get
- $300 in credit for the first 90 days
- Always-free tier: a small e2-micro VM, Cloud Storage, Cloud Functions quota and more
- Occasional extra credits through Google's student and cloud-skills programs

## How to claim
1. Start at [cloud.google.com/free](https://cloud.google.com/free).
2. Add a card to start the $300 trial (you won't be auto-charged when it ends).
3. Check your institution for Google Cloud student / skills-boost credits.

## Good to know
The trial needs a card for identity, but Google does not auto-bill when the trial ends. You choose whether to upgrade.
offers.verification: Google account (card required for trial); student programs vary
offers.eligibility: Anyone for the trial; extra credits via student programs

offers.title: JetBrains: free for students
offers.summary: Every JetBrains IDE (IntelliJ Ultimate, PyCharm Pro, WebStorm, more) free with a student licence.
offers.body:
A free JetBrains student licence gives you the **full professional versions** of every JetBrains IDE. These are the same paid tools used in industry, at no cost while you study.

## What you get
- IntelliJ IDEA **Ultimate**, PyCharm **Professional**, WebStorm, CLion, Rider, DataGrip and the rest
- The AI Assistant and all Pro features
- Works on Windows, macOS and Linux

## How to claim
1. Apply at [jetbrains.com/community/education](https://www.jetbrains.com/community/education/#students).
2. Verify with a university email, an ISIC card, or official enrolment documents.
3. Activate through your JetBrains Account or the Toolbox App.

## Good to know
The licence renews yearly while you remain eligible. If you graduate, you keep a perpetual fallback licence for the version you had.
offers.eligibility: Enrolled students and teachers at accredited institutions

offers.title: Free domain + SSL (Namecheap via Student Pack)
offers.summary: A free `.me` domain for one year plus a free SSL certificate, claimed through the GitHub Student Pack.
offers.body:
Good for a portfolio or first project: a **free `.me` domain for a year** plus a **free SSL certificate**, delivered through the GitHub Student Developer Pack and Namecheap's student program.

## What you get
- One free `.me` domain registration for 12 months
- A free SSL certificate to secure your site
- Standard Namecheap DNS management

## How to claim
1. First get the [GitHub Student Developer Pack](https://education.github.com/pack).
2. From the pack, open the Namecheap offer (or go to [nc.me](https://nc.me/)).
3. Register your `.me` domain and claim the SSL.

## Good to know
The first year is free; renewals are paid at normal rates, so set a reminder if you don't want to keep it. One domain per verified student.

offers.title: Notion for Education
offers.summary: Notion's Plus plan with AI, free for students and educators with a school email.
offers.body:
Notion for Education gives students the **Plus plan for free**: unlimited blocks, more collaboration, and Notion's note-taking and planning tools for coursework and projects.

## What you get
- Notion Plus features on your personal account
- Unlimited pages and blocks for notes, wikis and databases
- Templates for classes, assignments and study planning

## How to claim
1. Go to [notion.com/product/notion-for-education](https://www.notion.com/product/notion-for-education).
2. Sign up or add your school email to your account.
3. Verify the email to switch your personal plan to the education plan.

## Good to know
The education plan covers your **personal** workspace. AI features and exact inclusions can change, so check the current page for what's bundled.
offers.eligibility: Students and educators with a valid school email

offers.title: Perplexity Pro for students
offers.summary: Free or heavily discounted Perplexity Pro for students through its campus and .edu offers.
offers.body:
Perplexity regularly runs **student campaigns that make Pro free** (or a full year free) for verified `.edu` students and participating campuses. It helps with research, citations and coding.

## What you get
- Perplexity Pro: more powerful models, unlimited Pro searches, file uploads
- Better sourcing and follow-up reasoning for coursework and research

## How to claim
1. Check the current student offer on [perplexity.ai](https://www.perplexity.ai/) (look for the students / campus page).
2. Verify with your school email.
3. Some campaigns require signing up before a deadline or inviting classmates.

## Good to know
Student AI offers change often and vary by region. Confirm the exact current terms on Perplexity's site before relying on it.
offers.eligibility: Students; terms vary by country and campaign

offers.title: Spotify Premium Student
offers.summary: Premium at 50% off for students: ad-free music, offline listening, often bundled with extras.
offers.body:
Spotify Premium Student is **half price** for verified higher-ed students. You get the full Premium experience for the cost of a coffee.

## What you get
- Ad-free, on-demand music and podcasts
- Offline downloads and higher audio quality
- In some regions, bundled extras (e.g. an ad-supported streaming add-on)

## How to claim
1. Go to [spotify.com/student](https://www.spotify.com/student/).
2. Verify your enrolment through SheerID.
3. The discount applies to your existing Spotify account.

## Good to know
You can renew the student rate up to a set number of years (commonly 4) while you stay verified. Bundled extras vary by country.

offers.title: UNiDAYS student discounts
offers.summary: One free membership that gets you student discounts across hundreds of brands: fashion, tech, food, more.
offers.body:
UNiDAYS is a **free student-discount platform**. Verify once and get codes and deals across hundreds of brands in tech, fashion, food, software and travel.

## What you get
- Ongoing student discounts (often 10–40% off) at partner brands
- Tech and software deals (including some dev and creative tools)
- A single verification that works across the catalogue

## How to claim
1. Sign up free at [myunidays.com](https://www.myunidays.com/).
2. Verify your student status with your school email or documents.
3. Browse brands and reveal the discount codes.

## Good to know
Brand coverage and discount sizes vary by country. It's a discount marketplace, not a single deal, so treat it as a place to check before you buy.
offers.eligibility: Students registered with UNiDAYS (coverage varies by country)
